name: Oxfam
description: A global movement of people fighting inequality to end poverty and injustice, working across nearly every category of crisis.

name: World Food Programme
description: The UN agency delivering food assistance and working to tackle hunger and famine worldwide.

name: UNHCR
description: The UN Refugee Agency, supporting people forcibly displaced by conflict and persecution.

name: World Health Organization
description: Coordinates the global response to health emergencies and outbreaks.

name: International Red Cross
description: Provides emergency relief and support to communities affected by conflict and natural disasters.
